userReport.error: expected all tensors to be on the same device: cuda:1 and cpu

rootCause: The sharded path moved every tensor in PipelineState, including CPU text_token_tags, to CUDA. Diffusers builds packed tags on CPU and uses advanced indexed assignment from those text tags; CPU target and CUDA values fail before the model forward hook.
localReproduction: Actual CUDA reproduces the same error at MiniMaxH3PrepareLayoutStep.build_packed_sequence. The old transfer is exercised as a negative regression test.
fix: Keep text_token_tags on CPU, including normalization when an upstream caller supplied CUDA tags
Preserve CPU layout metadata; move encoded CUDA conditioning to the denoiser GPU
Filter state to actual denoiser inputs while preserving workflow triggers and kwargs mapping
Retain the caller-provided CPU RNG; do not change model precision, prompt, seed, duration or reference resolution

actualCudaTests.scope: Tiny H3 denoisers, not the full H100 model

limitations: Actual GPU tests use a tiny model on one RTX 3050 with torch 2.11/cu128, not the deployed H100 torch 2.7.1/cu126 environment
CUDA:0 to CUDA:1 state routing is metadata-only FakeTensor validation, not physical multi-GPU inference
A full-size H100 eight-GPU generation has not been measured
action: Stop the old up.sh process with Ctrl+C
